_comment: internOS — Claude Code lifecycle hooks. Merge these blocks into ~/.claude/settings.json (user-global) or your project's .claude/settings.json. Both hooks no-op silently when pwd is not inside an internOS workstream. SessionStart pre-loads BRIEF identity / STATUS / SESSIONS tail / open tick tasks / warnings into a system reminder before Claude's first response token. SessionEnd stamps BRIEF.md last_updated, appends a SESSIONS.md entry, runs sync-check on the workstream, and writes findings to .internos-warnings for the next SessionStart to surface. Note: do NOT use the `Stop` event for SESSIONS.md logging — `Stop` fires per agent turn, not at session end.
